criteria.requirement: Implement ftfy.pipeline.TextRepairPipeline(paths,config=None,*,missing="raise") with process(record,*,index=0), run(records,*,errors="raise") and frozen RecordResult(index,status,value,changes,error). Compose completed fix_fields and real audit.repair: retain only actual changed paths and replayable RepairResult summaries, preserve nonselected fields and original records. Reuse immutable config and normalized paths, stay lazy and independent between streams. Collect per-record domain/type/path errors and continue, retaining index and error type/text without exception objects; source iterator errors must propagate. Validate errors before consuming source and do not execute content as code.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
